title: Curry for What Ails You

{{Infobox Quest |image= File:BotW Curry for What Ails You.png |caption= |type= Side |game= BotW |giver= [[Lester]] |location= Rito Stable |prereq= |reward= {{Icon List|BotW|Purple Rupee}} |previous= |next= }} "{{Term/Store|Curry for What Ails You||Series, BotW}}" is a [[Side Quest]] in {{BotW}}.{{Cite|{{Big|Curry for What Ails You}}
{{Color BotW|Side Quest|Rito Stable}}|Adventure Log|BotW}} ==Overview== At [[Rito Stable]], [[Link]] will find [[Lester]], who is talking about his need for [[Curry Rice]] to himself.{{Cite|Need curry rice...|Lester|BotW}} When he speaks to him, Lester shares that he can not get enough spice,{{Cite|The thing about me is...I just can't get enough spice in my life.|Lester|BotW}} specifically requiring Curry Rice.{{Cite|Spicyyyyyyyyyyyyyyy... I need that burny tingle... I need {{Color BotW|Blue|curry rice}}!|Lester|BotW}} While he is in possession of the [[Hylian Rice]] needed to make the meal, he does not have any [[Goron Spice]].{{Cite|Now, I have {{Color BotW|Blue|Hylian rice}} on hand, which I need to make {{Color BotW|Blue|curry rice}}, but I'm fresh out of {{Color BotW|Blue|Goron spice}}!|Lester|BotW}} Unable to leave the [[Stable]] on a whim,{{Cite|I can't just run off and leave the stable.|Lester|BotW}} he asks Link to bring him some Goron Spice if he ever has any.{{Cite|If you happen to get your hands on some {{Color BotW|Blue|Goron spice}}, can you give it to me?|Lester|BotW}} If Link agrees to help, Lester thanks him.{{Cite|[Sure thing!] Thank you kindly, sonny boy.|Lester|BotW}} He shares that Curry Rice warms him up when he eats it.{{Cite|{{Color BotW|Blue|Curry rice}} always warms me right up.|Lester|BotW}} This begins the [[Side Quest]]. Goron Spice is sold at the [[Goron Gusto Shop]] in [[Goron City]]. The [[Merchant]] [[Yammo]] also sells Goron Spice. Once Link has obtained some, he can return to Rito Stable. Lester notices if it is in his [[Inventory]] and asks to see it.{{Cite|What's that? You got your hands on some {{Color BotW|Blue|Goron spice}}?
Can you show it to me?|Lester|BotW}} Lester confirms that it is indeed Goron Spice and asks to purchase it in exchange for 50 [[Rupee]]s.{{Cite|That's {{Color BotW|Blue|Goron spice}} all right! Hey... Could I ask you to part with that {{Color BotW|Blue|Goron spice}} for, say, {{Color BotW|Red|50 rupees}}?|Lester|BotW}} If Link agrees, Lester remarks that he will now be able to make Curry Rice.{{Cite|[It's all yours!] Thank you! With {{Color BotW|Blue|Goron spice}} and {{Color BotW|Blue|Hylian rice}}, I'll be able to make some {{Color BotW|Blue|curry rice}} to warm my soul.|Lester|BotW}} He gives Link a [[Purple Rupee]] as payment.{{Cite|Here—your {{Color BotW|Red|50 rupees}}!|Lester|BotW}} Afterwards, Link can continue to give Goron Spice to Lester in exchange for Hylian Rice.{{Cite|If you come across any more {{Color BotW|Blue|Goron spice}}, please bring it to me. Next time, I'll trade you some {{Color BotW|Blue|Hylian rice}} for it.|Lester|BotW}} He also tells Link that he can make other types of curry by adding extra ingredients.{{Cite|If you add other ingredients to {{Color BotW|Blue|Goron spice}} and {{Color BotW|Blue|Hylian rice}}, you can make all kinds of different curry rice dishes. Try it next time you have some spare ingredients.|Lester|BotW}} Once he is done talking, the Side Quest will be completed. ===Objectives=== {{Quest Objectives |- | 1 | Lester from the Rito Stable in the Tabantha Frontier asked for {{Color BotW|Red|Goron Spice}}, an ingredient for curry rice.

Get some {{Color BotW|Red|Goron Spice}} and deliver it to Lester at the Rito Stable. |- | Complete | Lester from the Rito Stable in the Tabantha Frontier taught you to make curry rice. The base ingredients are {{Color BotW|Red|Hylian rice}} and {{Color BotW|Red|Goron spice}}. You can add different ingredients to the base recipe to make all sorts of curry rice.

Should you ever be in need of {{Color BotW|Red|Hylian rice}}, he will trade you for some {{Color BotW|Red|Goron spice}}. }} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Goron Spice * Lester * Rito Stable }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |side-quests= BotW }}
